headline: RBI issues Directions, 2026 on cash withdrawals via ATMs and POS terminals
reference: Reserve Bank of India (Cash Withdrawal Transactions through Automated Teller Machines and Point of Sale Terminals) Directions, 2026
summary_points: RBI has published the Cash Withdrawal Transactions through ATMs and POS Terminals Directions, 2026 on its Notifications page.
The available page shows only the title and a PDF link (about 309 kb); the operative provisions are not visible in the text provided.
Details such as limits, charges, applicability and effective date could not be confirmed from the material available.
Banks, card networks and white-label ATM operators should read the full PDF to understand the compliance impact.
who_is_affected: Banks, white-label ATM operators, card networks, POS merchants and customers using ATMs or POS terminals for cash withdrawal.
action_required: Download and read the full Directions from the RBI website to confirm the provisions and effective date, then align internal policies and systems.

Why it matters:
- Banks and ATM operators may need to review their cash withdrawal processes.
- Merchants offering cash withdrawal at POS terminals may be affected.
- Customers may see changes in how cash can be withdrawn.

Finance and compliance teams should read the full Directions and map them to existing policies, systems and customer communications.

Please verify the details with the official RBI source before acting.
